purpose: 自行制作、散件采购与装配

notes.controller: 现成XIAO整板，自带Type-C与充电，无须另买充电模块。
notes.battery: User selected3200mAh18650. FLY.18650.3200.3C is a bare3.6V cell,typ3200/min3100mAh,max18.6x65.2mm,46g. No built-in protection claimed. Supplier spot-welded tabs/leads plus the new PCB protection are required; no direct cell soldering. Datasheet pp4,7-8.
notes.motor: 12x10mm gearbox;3mm D-shaft;4.995:1 internal and3.75:1 belt reduction. Single-cell performance is extrapolated; initial60%PWM, winding current <=0.375A. Long-life carbon brushes; no interchangeable generic N20 accepted without matching motor curve.
notes.led_star: Finished COB light source on its own aluminium substrate,4000K,Ra>=80,13.5x13.5x1.5mm,LES11.2mm. At300mA,Tc25C:570/620/680lm and14/16/18V. Selected nominal266.7mA,approximately4W. The substrate size does not limit brightness to0.5W. Optical/thermal validation of the assembled lamp remains necessary. Datasheet pp2-5.
notes.magnet: Ø30×2mm钕铁硼圆片，不用带壳加厚型。槽深1.5mm；磁力和涂层钢架上的保持力仍需验证。
notes.bearings: 6800标准轴承10×19×5mm，优先低摩擦金属防尘盖型ZZ；不能改变摩擦负载后仍沿用未验证的电机结论。
notes.connection_pcb: 40x50mm6层1.6mm，76器件；采用现用a775a125f18a8423be0a2ba88a937e442a0c12100c13393ab9c8c7c26812f82e制造包，按键板b957cd2114d3ced53b0880e8878ea2964d1e2e989303f3763fdcc0b3ff58ff3a。CAD旧导入来源保留，机械兼容比较不能改写来源。用户自行双面回流及穿孔焊接，不把空自动SMT清单当包焊订单。
notes.key_pcbs: 同一14×18mm按键板制作2块，2层FR4、1.6mm；左右同板不同装配朝向。
notes.headers_2: J2 raw cell, J3 motor, J4 COB, J5/J6 keys, J7 fan enable; choose0.64mm square-pin2.54mm vertical family rated>=3A for power circuits.
notes.key_headers: 主板普通2P六组+J12一组；按键板另2组；NTC三组另列。不要将合计数量混写成同一BOM行。
notes.female_housing_2: Seven mainboard housings:J2,J3,J4,J5,J6,J7,J12;14mm total installed height. Side-window ends are separate low-profile solder sockets;do not buy nine standard crimp housings.
notes.female_housing_7: J1;0.64mm square mating pins,7contacts;wire fanout to XIAO solder pads.
notes.female_contacts: 24 loose matching crimp contacts=7x2+7+3 for mainboard generic housings;window sockets include their own4contacts;three TE probe plugs use separate6TE contacts. >=3A for power contacts.
notes.power_wire: 24AWG red1m+black1m for protected PACK,motor and shared GND;raw cell leads supplied by spot-weld service. Finished cuts in harness table;no RAW negative Y split.
notes.signal_wire: H01/H04/H05/H06/H07/H08 stock;total4m includes>=0.5m white for visible optical cavity. Finished26AWG OD<=1.1mm to match fanout/tip envelopes;NTC adapter OD0.89-1.4mm as separately specified. White COB insulation uses red/yellow end labels,not an extra thick sleeve.
notes.led_spreader: Custom machined solid metal part;COB platform and both shell-contact branches are one piece. Replaces15 aluminium pieces,including6 separate liners;no separate thermal contact shoes or internal clamp screws. Keep electrically insulating thin shell TIM and COB bond.
notes.drive_belt: Nominal5.53% neutral-line stretch at23mm centres,30/8mm pitch diameters. Hidden motor slots give+/-0.3mm adjustment. Choose actual preload by slip,current and bearing-temperature tests.
notes.suspension_bolt: 暂缓直接下单：M4×90 ISO10642沉头内六角，A2/304，90mm含头。尚无完全匹配现货证据，向紧固件商询价；不能换成ISO4762圆柱头或DIN965十字沉头。
notes.suspension_nut: M4 ISO4032普通六角螺母，螺距0.7mm；没有另加垫圈或加厚件的空间验证。
notes.led_thermal_adhesive: Thin bond to finished COB metal substrate;keep light-emitting area and terminals clean. Thermal contact resistance target<=0.75K/W.
notes.bearing_retaining_adhesive: 须供应商明确兼容PETG和钢，只粘外圈，不进入滚道；不默认用仅适于金属的厌氧胶。
notes.diffuser_reversible_adhesive: 可剥离弹性胶，灯罩及覆盖窗框使用；先验证PETG粘接与透光外观。
notes.magnet_adhesive: PETG/镀镍钕铁硼兼容的薄胶层，固定磁铁。
notes.main_rotor_print: 250mm一体旋翼，厚度保持1.6mm；需更大有效平台或打印服务，动平衡和允许转速尚未验证。
notes.usb_cable: 必须支持数据，插头包胶在入口处≤12.35×6.5mm；XIAO插口实际高度尚待样板适配核对。
notes.usb_adapter: 普通合规5V≥1A电源，不用9V/12V诱骗板。
notes.bias_resistors: R2 fan-input pulldown,R4 lamp EN pulldown,R5 USB sense divider top,R10 fan nFAULT pullup,100kohm each.
notes.usb_sense_bottom: Two150kohm resistors:R6 USB sense bottom andR7 fan VREF divider top.
notes.switches: 两块按键板各1只6×6×4.3mm，不能改买不同总高的按钮。
notes.fan_driver: Current regulation and latched stall shutdown at1S voltage; no Basic candidate with the same functions was found. WQFN requires reflow assembly.
notes.motor_mount_screws: Through2mm motor plate into existing threaded metal gearbox;1mm engagement.
notes.motor_pulley_epoxy: Spot at exposed D-shaft/pulley end provides axial retention only. Do not bond motor bearing or gearbox; replace pulley and motor together for service.
notes.led_regulator: TPS61500 analog-dimming boost topology,2.9-18V input,200mV feedback,3A minimum switch-current limit;3A is NOT LED output current. Rsense0.75ohm1%,nom266.7mA;DIMC1uF,EN5kHz. Selected for full1S discharge coverage and matched14-18V COB; obsolete MEL7135/Q2 path cannot drive this source. Datasheet pp3-6,10-15,18-19.
notes.internal_carrier_print: Side-loaded through left/right clamshell;one printed chassis replaces multiple brackets. Final support clearances and mount-screw length are set by the CAD build. Retains removable battery gate and25mm strap.
notes.battery_foam: Include films,wrap and welded tabs within the reserved19x66.2mm pack envelope;do not add a70mm protected-cell variant.
notes.thermal_probes: HNTC-103F3950FB-100P finished epoxy-bead probe,10kohm1%,B25/50=3950K1%,100+/-5mm overall length INCLUDING bead,not free lead length,head max2.8x7.5mm. Typical tau<=15s in liquid; installed thermal lag must be checked. Remote sensors on COB,opaque-shell hot spot and battery. Datasheet pp1,3. Wire gauge is unspecified; do not crimp unknown probe wire directly into22-26AWG terminal. Commission a26AWG terminated adapter with staggered insulated splices.
notes.gate_resistors: R1 filtered DRV8213 VCC feed100ohm;R3 TPS61500 EN control series100ohm.
notes.fixed_windows: Pale-blue pane with37.5mm register,42.6mm shoulder; separate12mm button in12.5mm clearance hole; internal retaining ring; independent white overlay frame.
notes.skid_print: Curved struts; rail Z=-51.25mm,Y=+/-56.25mm; mounts X=+/-22.5mm,Z=-25mm;26.25mm vertical drop; front/rear symmetric; internally retained5mm pins.
notes.tail_print: Solid circular taper and full-round4mm locating plug with circular bearing shoulder; two hidden axial M2 screws. Symmetric vertical fin and same-half-profile right trim are integral; left white decorative tail propeller is separate.
notes.tail_prop_print: White three-blade decorative left tail propeller; centre[176.875,-4.625,13.75]mm; aft offset1.875mm;3mm pin in3.5mm blind socket.
notes.window_bezel_left_print: Independent white PETG ring covering pale-blue window edge by 0.5mm; curved back follows cabin surface with nominal 0.15mm glue allowance; free curved adhesive interface.
notes.window_bezel_right_print: Independent white PETG ring covering pale-blue window edge by 0.5mm; curved back follows cabin surface with nominal 0.15mm glue allowance; free curved adhesive interface.
notes.internal_mount_screws: Single rear horizontal chassis clamp plus front locating pin;length verified by screw-joint build.
notes.battery_strap: One 25mm strap centred Y=0 replaces two 10mm straps;cradle groove widened to26mm. Top overlap only;axial end gate and two buffers retained.
notes.controller_mount_screws: Optional charging-fit coupon only;main XIAO support is integral and uses no separate mounting screws.
notes.heat_mount_screws: Through3mm aluminium collector into kit-generated ASA pilot joints;do not substitute the former4mm length.
notes.window_retainer_print: Internal U-ring and curved saddle feet clamp each pane shoulder against the100mm cabin; twoM2x6 per window.
notes.window_retainer_screws: Four internal M2x6 socket-cap screws, two per pane; kit-derived nominal geometry, printed fit still needs coupon.
notes.skid_root_caps_print: Four independently printable curved saddle caps,9.2mm OD,6.7mm cavity; two per skid, matching the sphere interior.
notes.skid_root_screws: Four M2x8 socket-cap screws into5mm locating pins; internal heads; kit-derived nominal geometry, printed fit still needs coupon.
notes.rotor_bearing_spacer_print: 7.9mm spacer bears only on the two6800 outer races; separate from stationary inner spacer.
notes.charging_fit_shell_print: Test fixture only;main unit uses integral chassis rails. Two M1.6x5 screws belong to coupon,not final lamp.
notes.fan_bulk: 47uF10V1206 local motor input bulk; capacitance under DC bias must be checked on prototype.
notes.led_inductor: MHCC06030-100M-R7 shielded10uH20%,DCR68mohm max,Isat5.5A typ at30% inductance drop,Irms4A typ at40C rise;7.3x6.6x3mm. At8uH and assumed480kHz low-frequency bound,calculated worst switch peak2.49A. Supplier datasheet pp2,17 marks series not for new design; accepted for limited-stock prototype,requires lifecycle substitution review before production.
notes.led_schottky: SS3P6L-M3/86A,60V3A,TO-277A,chosen from TPS61500 recommended diode family; reverse rating exceeds40V switch rating. AverageLED current<=0.277A; calculated inductor peak2.49A. Datasheet pp1-2; footprint/polarity to be checked in PCB revision.
notes.thermal_adc: ADS1115IDGSR,3.3V I2C four-input ADC: AIN0 COB NTC,AIN1 shell NTC,AIN2 battery NTC,AIN3 divided protected battery. ADDR ground gives0x48;100nF bypass,4.7k I2C pull-ups. Uses explicitly remapped XIAO D7/GPIO20 SDA and D6/GPIO21 SCL; default I2C GPIO6/7 already drive loads. Datasheet pp3-5,11,23.
notes.battery_protection_ic: BQ29700DSER1S protector:OVP4.275V,UVP2.8V,OCD100mV20ms,SCD500mV250us nominal. Common-drain back-to-back low-side FET application with330ohm BAT filter,100nF,2.2kohm V-minus resistor,5Mohm gate-source bleeds. All loads and XIAO charging connect to PACK side,never bypass CELL-minus. Datasheet pp4-8,21-22.
notes.battery_protection_fets: Five paralleled back-to-back pairs using each CSD85301Q2 independent dual N-MOS;join drains externally,balanced copper. Rds each max39mohm atVgs2.5V,Tj25C;combined five-pair path max15.6mohm. One pair would trigger100mV protection too early at this load. Design bound1.5x hot Rds plus3mohm traces gives26.4mohm,85mV minimum OCD=>3.22A above2.63A load budget. Hot factor and sharing require prototype measurement; protector is not a calibrated current limiter. Datasheet pp1,3-4.
notes.battery_fuse: Littelfuse0451004.MRL,4A125V very-fast fuse,2410;series raw cell positive at battery entry. Datasheet p2 givesRnom16mohm andI2t3.152A2s;catalogI2t0.0551 is inconsistent and NOT used. Secondary fault protection,not a4A constant-current limiter. Startup inrush/temperature coordination must be tested.
notes.led_sense_resistor: Rsense Kelvin route,200mV nominal;nom266.67mA,bounds257.43..276.09mA including195..205mV FB and1%R;maxdissipation0.0566W.
notes.led_freq_resistor: TPS61500 FREQ nominal600kHz;frequency tolerance not specified for this exact resistor in datasheet,480kHz used as sensitivity assumption,not guaranteed limit.
notes.led_ovp_bottom: OVP lower resistor;above LED14..18V plus3%VF measurement bound andFB0.205V.
notes.led_soft_start: SS soft-start capacitor per TI guidance.
notes.led_compensation: COMP to ground;layout and loop response must be checked on new board.
notes.led_dim_filter: DIMC to ground selects analog dimming;5kHz EN input. Start with continuous HIGH>=50ms before reducing duty;datasheet minimum start PWM on-time is200us,not20us.
notes.led_input_cap: Local VIN/PGND bypass,effective>=3.3uF at4.2V;shared battery bulk capacitor remains.
notes.led_output_caps: 4.4uF nominal total,require>=2.2uF combined at21.7V from chosen supplier DC-bias curve;1..10uF effective output range.
notes.led_bleeder: Across boosted output to discharge capacitance;do not hot-plug COB at charged output.
notes.temperature_pullups: 3.3V to each NTC node,NTC toPACK_GND;maxNTC selfheat0.273mW at3.3V.
notes.temperature_input_filter: Series ADC input resistors;separate analogue returns from switching ground.
notes.temperature_filter_caps: One per ADC input;NTC settling and multiplexer timing handled in firmware.
notes.battery_adc_bottom: AIN3 divider bottom,2.1V nominal at4.2V battery.
notes.protection_gate_bleeds: Shared CHG/DSG gate-to-source bleed resistors,close to paired FET bank.
notes.thermal_header: Internal extension forXIAO3V3,D7 SDA,D6 SCL;not an exterior port.
notes.probe_headers: Three internal probe ports,NTC input plus ground;avoid swapped channels.
notes.probe_female_housings: TE supplier drawing p1: housing2P A5.59+0.25/-0.13mm,12.95mm axial length,6.60mm max cross section,pitch2.54mm;accepts1375819 family. J10/J11 rotated90degrees,row alongX,centreX13.35;conservative installed/service reserve6.5x9x20mm includes14mm plug and6mm bend allowance. 3 probes labelled COB/SHELL/BAT. Supplier drawing envelope,not a supplier STEP model.
notes.battery_spot_weld_service: Exact bare cell with nickel tabs,positive insulating ring,24AWG red/black leads supplied by battery service;cut stock125/165mm,trim on routing jig. Wrapped cell reserveØ19x66.2mm;do not solder directly to cell.
notes.internal_reflector: Single connected ASA print combines reflector and two supports,retains original M1.6 mounting joints and screw positions;two bonded interfaces removed. Remove collector first,then withdraw entire insert through nose.
notes.protected_battery_header: NewPACK+/-outputtoXIAOBAT+/BAT-;allXIAOgroundsPACK-side. Do not reuse raw-cell negative as ground.
notes.led_bias_link: R31 populated0ohm0603 separates the TPS61500 VIN-bias/C3 branch from the 3A inductor feeder.
notes.protection_vss_link: R32 populated0ohm0603 forms Kelvin raw-cell-negative reference for U4 VSS,C15 bypass andR19 discharge gate bleed; not a load return.
notes.probe_crimp_contacts: Exact1375820 housing contact family;datasheet p1:22-26AWG,insulationOD0.89-1.65mm. Crimp only onto specified26AWG adapter wire,not unspecified factory probe lead.
notes.ntc_guide_ties: Two2.5x100 ties:one softly anchors H10 alongside+Y motor post,one closes existing lower guide for H11. New H01 guide tie is separately listed.
notes.battery_cradle_print: Only the removable end gate is printed separately;cradle belongs to the unit chassis. Preserve two M2 gate screws and terminal/cushion clearances.
notes.battery_gate_screws: Kit-generated recessed joints atX=+/-11.3,Y=24,Z=-8mm. Self-forming PETG pilot holes;no metal tapping of the printed part.
notes.battery_end_spacers: Axial buffers between cell end faces and end stops atY=+/-36.4,Z=-21mm. Keep terminal centre and spot-welded lead exits clear.
notes.noncuring_thermal_filler: Only thin electrically insulating shell-contact interfaces;no filler interfaces within monolithic thermal bridge.
notes.probe_retention_tape: Hold battery NTC over a thin non-curing thermal layer so it can be removed without stripping the cell sleeve. COB and liner probes use insulating thermal adhesive away from solder pads and emitting area.
notes.hex_key_1p5: Manufacturer90/4.5mm arms,Wera05022040001. Tool geometry checks include5mm threaded withdrawal,60degree re-indexing,key disengagement and ordinary hand seating/removal of freed screws. Shaft envelope1.8mm,bend envelope4.5mm are conservative engineering defaults;actual fit/torque not measured.
notes.female_housing_3: J8;3matching contacts included in24 loose contacts;0.64mm square mating pins.
notes.key_low_profile_sockets: 采购/线束定制规格已确定：2.54mm1x2焊线母座，壳<=8.5mm、总深<=11.5mm、含热缩截面<=3x5.6mm；不是已经取得厂家认证STEP的特定商品。先让供应商按此规格交样，外形大于包络不得直接代替。
notes.controller_guide_tie: Closes new H01 open guide. Release or replace for deep service;do not compress wire insulation.
notes.procurement_mode: 用户自行制作和装配散件，不购买厂家上下功能总成或代接线/代烧录/代校准服务。电芯使用有点焊引线规格，不在裸电芯上直接锡焊。
notes.current_stock: 电子件库存/价格沿用前次目录查询，仅作历史参考；本次未声称国内平台全有现货。电机Pololu3060和M4x90 ISO10642仍须询价确认交期。
notes.print_scope: 31整机打印件；可选USB试配2件另列；线束/插壳/电子件/金属桥/缓冲垫均不打印。
notes.polyimide_purchase: 同一卷10mm宽、厚≤0.06mm胶带覆盖绝缘及探头固定两行用途。
